preserveIntent.originalMessage: Jalapeño returns a complete response faster than the comparison systems across GPT-OSS, DeepSeek R1, and Kimi K2.5.
preservedElements: GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek R1 670B, and Kimi K2.5 1T in the original order
Jalapeño versus GB200 or GB300 comparison for every model
Exact end-to-end latency values in seconds
OpenAI source URL and official comparison labels
changedElements: Recomposed the comparisons as a grouped bar chart for quick model-by-model reading
Used direct labels with the comparison hardware name and exact two-decimal seconds
Added a short plain-language Korean headline and subtitle
Kept a shared zero-based seconds axis; no inversion or normalization was introduced

preserveIntent.notes: All six latency values are copied from OpenAI’s official appendix. Lower bars mean a shorter wait for the complete response.

qualityChecks.label: Grouped bar layout planned
qualityChecks.detail: Three model groups, two bars per group, a shared 0–6.5 second axis, direct labels, and a lower-is-better subtitle were planned before JSON authoring.

qualityChecks.label: Exact official OpenAI data
qualityChecks.detail: 1.03 vs 1.80; 1.65 vs 5.99; and 1.56 vs 5.31 seconds match the OpenAI appendix exactly.

qualityChecks.label: Latency direction is explicit
qualityChecks.detail: The subtitle says lower is better, and the zero-based seconds axis makes shorter response time visually clear.

qualityChecks.label: KO/EN data parity
qualityChecks.detail: KO and EN use identical x order, numeric values, series order, series colors, source URL, and comparison hardware.

narrative.summary: End-to-end latency는 요청을 보낸 뒤 답변을 끝까지 받기까지 걸리는 시간입니다.
narrative.story: 막대가 짧을수록 답변을 더 빨리 끝까지 받을 수 있습니다. Jalapeño는 세 모델 모두에서 비교 GPU보다 짧은 시간을 보였습니다.
narrative.viewerAction: 각 모델 그룹에서 더 짧은 청록색 막대가 더 빠른 응답을 뜻한다는 점을 먼저 봅니다.

focusPoint.reason: The largest comparison latency makes the lower-is-better gap easy to understand.
